annotations.title: Watch a channel or topic for new videos

description: Get the transcript of every new video from a YouTube channel, or every new video matching a search phrase, delivered by email and/or webhook. Checked hourly; videos already published are skipped. Each delivered transcript costs 1 credit. Paid plans and credit packs only. Give exactly one of channel or query.

ai.description: AI-transcribe videos still without captions after 6 hours (1 credit per started minute)

email.description: Email the account owner when new transcripts are ready

query.description: Search phrase to watch for (e.g. a brand name)

webhook_url.description: https URL to POST each transcript to
